programme.title: The Sound Collector
programme.desc: The Sound Collector tries to help Mole hear the stars at night by giving them a sound.

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: It's the great bouncy ball hunt. Pants and his dad won last year, and Pants is determined to win it again this year, but it's not as easy as he remembered.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: MeMo and BaBa need to find the right home for the squishy ball they've been playing with.

programme.title: The Fantus Show
programme.desc: A toaster and gingerbread come to life and two toys sing "Father Jacob".

programme.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programme.desc: Eddie goes to the cinema with Akil and Nina, learning to enjoy himself even when it gets a little noisy.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's an adventure on the high seas as Bluey, Bingo and Missy play Pirates on the hammock swing, but they'll need to find their courage to withstand storms and whale attacks.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Do bubbles need socks? Fizzy and Suds follow wool from sheep to factory, exploring sock pairs, sock puppets, and a magical "missing sock" disco.

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programme.desc: Clarence and the kids learn all about regenerative farming and treat the soil to a pampering session. Then they create their own day spa to treat themselves.

programme.title: The Wiggles: Wiggle and Learn
programme.desc: It's time to Wiggle and Learn! Join The Wiggles as they embark on a journey to explore and discover more about planes. Then, it's time to look in the dress-up box and create a pretend aeroplane.

programme.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
programme.desc: Absorbing Man steals a gem that deflects the Iron Friends' beams, forcing them to find a new way to stop him.

programme.title: Mecha Builders
programme.desc: The Zee Mobile can count chickens at the farm, but needs the Mecha Builders to step in when it won't stop crashing into MacBarm's barn door.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programme.desc: When Thomas loses his voice, he must find a new way to pass on a very important message.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa and her friends are building a desert island, in the sandpit. They add a forest, a lake, houses, and shops. It's all going very well until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: It is night time at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails. But what other night animals will they find?

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: Lou has a series of misadventures whilst fast asleep and Kiri exhausts herself trying to keep him safe.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: Split becomes protective of a young seedling resembling their signature sprout.

programme.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programme.desc: Ben, Holly and Gaston the Ladybird find a large egg in the meadow. A tiny chick hatches from the egg and the children must find the mummy bird.

programme.title: Vida the Vet
programme.desc: Otto's stinky feet smell like cheese. Vida helps and everyone is happy except Sunny, who loves cheese!

programme.title: Talking Tom Heroes: Suddenly Super
programme.desc: The Heroes try to make it through a rescue without revealing their identities to Ginger, who won't stop hanging around.

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.desc: It's a nighttime chase above and below the sea when Escarlata turns the moon into a fish.

programme.title: PJ Masks: Power Heroes
programme.desc: Catboy and Bastet rivalry and egos causes them to fall for Pharaoh boy's plan.

programme.title: The Octonauts
programme.desc: Kwazii finds a mysterious, unbreakable coconut, so the Octonauts seek out the help of some large, island-dwelling coconut crabs to open it.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: The Squirrels want to get a World Record, but in what? And Duggee is too busy to help. "If only we had more Duggee" muses Tag. Which gives Norrie a record-breaking idea.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: Things get out of hand when Neville's plan for a peaceful day of floating on the river turns into a wild race.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: On an adventure with the Pioneers, Professor Pickles wants to do things as his ancestors did, until his boat sinks and he needs a modern-day rescue!

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay

programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay are detectives today. When the homemade appalams go missing under their watch, they need to solve the case and save lunch!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Twelve and friends go on a spectacular space mission to save Numberland from the mysterious Block Star.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: Space inspires Murphi and Rebecca's creations, including an alien made from a sock. Some cotton wool helps cardboard tubes become a space rocket. Is the attic ready for lift off?

programme.title: Mittens & Pants
programme.desc: Pants has a very special present for his mom's birthday. But when Petunia comes over to help him wrap it, he's worried he didn't do a good enough job.

programme.title: Play School: Playtime With Pets
programme.desc: Abi and Teo meet a bearded dragon, gidgee skink and a knob-tailed gecko! Abi shows how to slither like a snake, Teo makes a craft blue-tongued lizard pet and Jemima builds a friendly garden for her animal friends to visit.

programme.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Fizzy and Suds meet the penguins! See them snuggle, waddle, nap, and slide. From gentoo to king penguins, it's a chilly, splashy, fishy adventure full of fun.

programme.title: Lil' stompers

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs

programme.title: Gardening Australia Junior

programme.title: Santiago of the Seas
programme.sub-title: The Lost Girl in the Canoe
programme.desc: The crew meet a Chamorro girl with a broken canoe who has been magically transported to their ocean.

programme.title: Superkitties

programme.title: Hey Duggee

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the 80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
